_comment: MORPH: THE LEAD FLIP BEFORE A POWER-LOCKING PUMP (Morph INT-2, 2026-11-11).
Turn 3: a face-down Blistering Firecat that entered on turn 2 (not summoning sick), three Mountains and
two Forests untapped, Berserk + Temur Battle Rage in hand. Turn it face up ({R}{R}: 7/1 haste trample),
Berserk it ({G}: +7/+0 = 14), Temur Battle Rage ({1}{R}: double strike) -> 28 to an opponent at 20.
DISCRIMINATING: Berserk locks X at resolution, so flipping AFTER Berserk gives 2 -> 4 -> 9 power,
18 double-strike damage, not lethal. Only the LEAD position (the flip before the plan's casts) wins.
